message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV and assigns column names but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: The dataset is fetched via tf.keras.utils.get_file from a hardcoded URL with no checksum, signature verification, or authentication provided.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only uses LabelEncoder to convert M/B to binary values but never validates label distributions, checks for unexpected label values, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset preparation applies StandardScaler and shuffling but includes no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a saved model with `tf.keras.models.load_model(MODELS_PATH)` in `acc_increase()` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the model's integrity before use.

No detected label distribution validation: The code does not perform any class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training; it simply loads and encodes the labels directly.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or applied anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is used, the test set is not cryptographically isolated (no hashing/signing), DO_SHUFFLE is False by default risking ordering bias, and there is no mechanism preventing the test set from influencing training or verifying data integrity.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path simply passes the raw command-line argument string directly to predict() with no shape, range, type, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No post-prediction checks for NaN, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds are visible anywhere in the inference code path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular/neural-network breast-cancer classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
